title: Implementar runner CI de atestación pública read-only para TTS
mission: Implement a bounded GitHub Actions network-attestation runner for the existing generic text-to-audio public candidate. The runner must fetch the exact public candidate, record HTTP status and served-content SHA-256, verify the known candidate/backend/maxChars markers, execute only the existing read-only health check, and persist evidence without sending any generation POST or making promotion claims.
definition_of_done: Add a deterministic CI script/workflow that fetches the exact public candidate and records HTTP status plus served-content SHA-256.
Verify the served HTML contains the expected candidate marker, backend reference and 1800-character contract, or record exact divergence.
Perform only the existing read-only health check and record status/body evidence consistent with maxChars=1800, or exact divergence.
Send no POST generation request and include a regression guard that prevents mutating generation calls in this verifier.
Persist machine-readable evidence suitable for disposition of the existing public-origin verification lane.
Do not promote Current, Human Accepted, Served, Catalog or /w authority.
